subject: general
question: What is the theme of the 15th edition of Asia’s biggest aero show, Aero India 2025?

options.text: The Runway to a Billion Opportunities

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Runway to a Billion Opportunities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 15th edition of **Aero India 2025**, Asia's largest aero show, will be held from **February 10 to February 14** at the Air Force Station, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka.
 
• The theme of the event is **"The Runway to a Billion Opportunities,"** focusing on accelerating indigenization and showcasing cutting-edge aerospace technologies.
 
• The event includes **air displays, static exhibitions**, and a showcase of military and aerospace platforms, attracting global and domestic participants.
 
• The India Pavilion will emphasize the **Make-in-India initiative**, demonstrating indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Business Days:** The first three days (February 10-12) are designated as business days for industry professionals and decision-makers.
 
• **Public Days:** February 13 and 14 are open to the general public, allowing them to witness dynamic aerobatic displays and technology demonstrations.
 
• **Global Participation:** The event attracts global CEOs, domestic PSU CMDs, private defence companies, and dignitaries from over 98 countries.
 
• **Aero India Legacy:** With 14 successful editions since 1996, Aero India has established itself as a premier global aerospace exhibition.
 
• **Previous Edition:** The last edition in 2023 saw participation from over **7 lakh visitors**, 809 exhibitors, and dignitaries from across the globe.
 
• **Significance:** Aero India serves as a unique platform for fostering partnerships between foreign and Indian firms, bolstering India’s aerospace and defence sectors.
